sn47.25:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthi, in Jeta’s Grove, Anathapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn47.25:1.3: Then a certain brahmin approached the Blessed One and exchanged greetings with him.
sn47.25:1.4: When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to the Blessed One:
sn47.25:1.5: “Master Gotama, what is the cause and reason why the true Dhamma does not endure long after a Tathagata has attained final Nibbāna?
sn47.25:1.6: And what is the cause and reason why the true Dhamma endures long after a Tathagata has attained final Nibbāna?”
sn47.25:2.1: “It is, brahmin, because the four establishments of mindfulness are not developed and cultivated that the true Dhamma does not endure long after a Tathagata has attained final Nibbāna.
sn47.25:2.2: And it is because the four establishments of mindfulness are developed and cultivated that the true Dhamma endures long after a Tathagata has attained final Nibbāna.
sn47.25:3.6: It is because these four establishments of mindfulness are not developed and cultivated …
sn47.25:3.7: are developed and cultivated that the true Dhamma endures long after a Tathagata has attained final Nibbāna.”
sn47.25:4.1: When this was said, that brahmin said to the Blessed One:
sn47.25:4.3: From today let Master Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
